title: Phase 1 foundation implemented: scaffold, typed core, OCFL SourceStore, ownership tests
body:
All Phase 1 steps (P1-S1..S4) DONE. Gate green: ruff 0, mypy strict 0, pytest UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true 23 passed (incl 9 postgres-marked). Key decisions/observations for future workers:

1. EMBEDDING VECTOR = JSONB (deviation from DD's pgvector). The production embedding.vector(N) column + pgvector extension is a later-phase build gate (pgvector 0.8.0 IS installed via postgresql-17-pgvector apt package, extension create('vector') works). We deliberately kept embedding.vector_json as JSONB so migrations run on bare Postgres without the extension. The embedding projection phase can swap in vector(N) with its own toggle. If a future phase wants pgvector now, run: CREATE EXTENSION vector; and alter embedding to add vector column.

2. env.py DSN resolution: migrations/env.py reads UMD_POSTGRES_DSN first, then umd.config default. Tests that migrate a fresh DB that must pin the engine URL, so the conftest migrated_db fixture sets UMD_POSTGRES_DSN during alembic_command.upgrade (otherwise env.py overrides the fixture URL and migrates the default 'umd' db). Preserve this when adding Postgres integration harnesses.

3. UUID ids carry server_default=gen_random_uuid() (PG13+ builtin) in addition to python uuid4 so raw-SQL inserts (tests/repositories) work without supplying id.

4. ocfl-py 2.1.0 API notes: ocfl.StorageRoot.initialize() REQUIRES the root dir to be ABSENT (raises if it exists). SourceStore.create() therefore rmdirs an empty pre-existing dir and rejects non-empty uninitialized dirs. Also NewVersion.version id is auto-numbered (v1..); user metadata passed via ocfl.VersionMetadata(name=..,address=..), NOT user_name.

5. No second service boundary was added; single src/umd tree, one editable package. Phase 2 begins at P2-S1 (domain models, segments, locators, provenance contracts) per plan transition.

title: Phase 2 domain/locator/resolution complete — key decisions
body:
Phase 2 (P2-S1..S4) DONE, 66 tests green (PG live), ruff clean, mypy strict clean (29 src files). Decisions worth preserving:
1. Byte-offset-only rejection: Locator's pydantic model_validator raises ByteOffsetLocatorError, which pydantic wraps into ValidationError on construction/parse. Tests must expect ValidationError with msg "byte-offset-only locator rejected", not ByteOffsetLocatorError directly. Semantic: deterministic segment ids are structural hashes, so a byte-offset selector is never a sufficient locator.
2. Version model: deterministic_key (identity#modality#norm_path) is version-INDEPENDENT; locator @v tag from PipelineVersion(segmenter.decoder.renderer). DB constraint UNIQUE(source_id,deterministic_key) => PG stores single row/key (PostgresSegmentStore). InMemorySegmentStore stores multiple @v per key to exercise explicit-vs-bare. Resolver EXPLICIT: exact @vN tag when stored, else falls back to newest (old @vN remains addressable via immutable bytes). Bare = newest by (version,tag).
3. SourceRange.sha512 is the AUTHORITATIVE full-source sha512 from OCFL source row, NOT a hash of the bounded body. provenance{ocfl_ref, content_sha512, size_bytes} links back to immutable bytes.
4. PG 'source'/'segment' id columns are UUID type => SQLAlchemy returns uuid.UUID on read; sources/repos convert .hex. IDs stored as uuid-hex (32 chars).
5. New PG source must exist before segment insert (FK).

title: Phase 3 complete: semantic authority + ingestion command path

Discovery worth noting for Phase D: the session-scoped `migrated_db` fixture is shared by every postgres test, so Phase-3 tests that count semantic_event/current_state/source rows cannot assume a clean DB. Added a `umd_db` fixture (tests/conftest.py) that TRUNCATEs the 22 disposable app tables before AND after each test (RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE), keeping the shared session DB pristine so Phase-1/2 tests (e.g. test_migrations.test_ledger_is_append_only expecting semantic_event==1) are not polluted. Also: (a) added jsonschema dep (spec requires validating payloads against retained schemas) + mypy override; (b) patch 15 event schemas to make optional scalar fields nullable (commands legitimately pass None); (c) SemanticLedger.append anchors idempotency_key to the first event row and returns read_your_writes_token = FIRST-event seq so a duplicate-key resubmission gets the identical token (max-seq would mismatch the keyed-row lookup on dedup); (d) ingestion reuses an existing source by content sha512 (source.sha512 UNIQUE) so re-uploading identical bytes never duplicates the source/event. Reducer p99 measured 0.045ms (target <=5ms). Dead-ends: None.

title: Phase 1 (P1-S1..S5) complete — discoveries for later phases
body:
Phase 1 done: DAG + durable stage execution + job commands + Hatchet seam + quilt tests. All gates green (lint 0, mypy --strict 0, UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true test = 160 passed = Plan A 112 + 48 new).

Discoveries / decisions worth recording for Phase 2-3 workers:
1. idempotency_material (manifest.py) deliberately EXCLUDES job_id — idempotency is evidence-derived so retry-under-new-job dedups against the original run. It INCLUDES dag_universe so old DAG-release runs never alias new-universe runs. Do not reintroduce job_id.
2. Deterministic stage idempotency keys are v4-masked UUIDs (deterministic_uuid) because stage_run.idempotency_key and semantic_event.idempotency_key are SAUuid columns — keys must be valid UUID strings.
3. Completion runs in ONE tx: new SemanticLedger.complete_and_append (ledger.py) folds events + side_effects(conn) atomically; side_effect updates stage_run. Use this for any stage that must commit artifacts+StageCompleted together.
4. PostgresJobRepository.get must return source_id as dashed str(uuid), NOT .hex — a hex form silently changed the manifest source_id and duplicated stage_run rows on retry (replayed claim was skipped because the key differed). Keep source_id round-trip stable or idempotency breaks.
5. migrations/versions/0002_jobs.py must be idempotent: 0001 uses metadata.create_all() which ALREADY creates the `job` table on fresh bootstraps. Guard with op.get_context().as_sql (NOT is_offline_mode() — that attr does not exist on MigrationContext) before inspect/table-creation.
6. LIMITATION (flagged for QA): the in-repo synchronous DurableDAGRunner walks STAGE_ORDER linearly; within a single run a failed parent does NOT block its children from scheduling (children still run with whatever upstream produced). Real dependency-gated scheduling (skip children when an upstream dep failed) is deferred to the Hatchet adapter. Invalidation/retry logic already prevents re-running completed stages and only drives descendant closures — that is where correctness is concentrated; tests cover it (test_jobs_postgres, test_job_commands).
7. Hatchet is a confirmed BUILD GATE: exact release pinned only after retry/cancel/restart shape tests (P1-S4 annotated). No live-Hatchet behavior was fabricated; HatchetRunner raises HatchetNotConfiguredError without a client. Tests use the DAGRunner seam (DurableDAGRunner + FakeExecutor / RecordingRunner).
8. Pre-existing (not mine): migrations/versions/0001_initial_core.py has 2 E501 line-too-long that are OUTSIDE the lint gate (make lint = ruff check src tests, 0001 is in migrations/).

title: Phase 3 raster: evidence cross-call dedup needs unique index (gap, out of scope)
body: PostgresEvidenceRepository.record dedups only WITHIN a single batch (in-memory `seen` set); across separate record() calls, the evidence table has NO unique constraint on (source_id, locator, evidence_kind, config_digest), so identical rows are re-inserted and `recorded.existing` is always empty on re-runs. This is a pre-existing Phase 2 repo behavior shared by text evidence, not a Phase 3 regression. Phase 3 test_raster_deterministic_and_idempotent asserts the plan's real determinism contract (deterministic segment IDs -> segment dedup; identical OCR/spatial output) and deliberately does NOT assert evidence-row cross-call dedup. To fully satisfy CONTRACTS "EvidenceRepository.record is idempotent" across calls, a UNIQUE index (migration) on evidence(source_id, locator, evidence_kind, config_digest) is needed — recommend a follow-up. Also: pipeline now always derives a deterministic non-null config_digest so evidence idempotency would work once the index exists.

title: Audio ParserProfile nproc_limit raised to 8192
body: Reference ASR sandboxed decode failed with OSError[Errno 11] EAGAIN when forking ffprobe. Root cause: SubprocessSandboxRunner sets RLIMIT_NPROC, which is enforced per real-UID across ALL processes AND threads of that UID, not just the sandboxed child. The host harness already runs >1000 threads under the opencode UID, exceeding the default SandboxLimits.nproc_limit=64 (and even 1024), so the decoder fork was starved. This is a legitimate per-workload adjustment: audio alone spawns streaming decoder subprocesses (unlike the pure-Python text parsers). Raised the audio ParserProfile nproc_limit to 8192 (bounded ceiling). RLIMIT_AS (512MB), CPU, timeout, fd caps, read-only spool and allowlists still enforce bounded containment. Independent-process battery confirmed the opaque threshold sits between 1024 and 2000.

title: Phase 3 (P3-S1..S4) video+subtitle baseline complete
body:
Phase 3 DONE. New packages src/umd/video/ and src/umd/subtitle/ + wired policies.py (video/subtitle profiles with nproc 8192 mirroring audio RLIMIT note) + capabilities.py disclosure. Key decisions:
- Heavy decode/scene paths GATED honestly: ffmpeg/ffprobe ACTIVE (reference), PyAV + PySceneDetect gated (reference provider used; never fabricate active). Capability disclosure in video_capability_report + subtitle_capability_report (both wired into capability_report()).
- PTS-native segments via locators.build_locator(t= selector); track segments typed by codec_type (video/audio/subtitle), not 'track'.
- Video file-scope METADATA dedup hazard found+victory: postgres dedup keys on (source_id, locator, evidence_kind, config_digest). Multiple METADATA obs + composition all used locator 'video/file/1' and got collapsed to one. FIXED by distinct locators video/file/1#observation/<kind>/<i> and video/file/1#composition/audio. Future: never share a locator across distinct METADATA facts.
- Subtitle extraction: matroska stores subrip+ass BOTH as codec 'ass'; extraction uses global stream index -map 0:N (NOT per-type 0:s:N which matches no streams). Extract via -c:s <native> -f <mux> transcode preserving styles, bounded to 4MB.
- pysubs2 1.9.0: SSAFile.from_string autodetect works for srt/ass/webvtt/ttml/sami/mpl2; microdvd needs fps=25 and tmp needs explicit reader (H:MM:SS:text). NOT from_string for those two.
- WebVTT X-TIMESTAMP-MAP: shift = MPEGTS/90000 - LOCAL; strip header BUT keep 'WEBVTT' magic line so pysubs2 autodetect still routes to webvtt (removing it made autodetect fail); transformation recorded incl formula, applied/header_stripped flags.
- charset: cp1252 always decodes all bytes, so latin-1 surrogateescape branch was unreachable; added C0/C1 control-char detection to route foreign high bytes to surrogate-preserving path (DD-mandated).
- Tests: 17 new (test_subtitle_parse.py standalone + test_video_subtitle_integration.py postgres). Full suite UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true: 302 passed (was 285). lint 0, mypy --strict 0 (118 files).
- NO flatten invariant: each embedded subtitle track is stored as its OWN OCFL source (independent source_id) and recorded as a separate subtitle_event evidence stream; independent_track quality carries the track identity. Bitmap codecs (dvd_subtitle/xsub/etc) -> QUARANTINE records (never dropped, never promised text-decodable).

title: Phase-2 replay-built projections complete (12 tests, 338 total)
body:
Phase 2 (P2-S1..P2-S5) of TASK-universal-media-decomposer-D-resolution-query-api implemented and verified. New package src/umd/projections/ (base.py ReplayDriver + ProjectionBuilder protocol, checkpoint.py, poison.py, current.py, search.py, vector.py, query.py, publish.py, tables.py, embedder.py). Behavior: single-writer checkpointed builders replay upcast semantic events in seq order, fold every semantic event through the ONE shared CurrentStateReducer (cross-tier equivalence), SKIP only non-authoritative quarantined noise, and PAUSE on authority-relevant events with an exposed reason + explicit resume. Blue/green publish builds into proj_<name>_<gen> schemas with a grace period and per-connection search_path; stale pooled readers see OLD (not new) data and error after the dropped schema. Search uses native tsvector GIN + pg_trgm; vectors are append-only immutable embedding rows behind a VectorIndex whose exact in-process fallback is ACTIVE by default and whose pgvector HNSW backend is honestly GATED (requires extension >=0.8.2; this env has 0.8.0 -> active()==False). QueryService.structured() delivers the bounded-relational graph-like engine (entities/utterances/scenes/evidence/correspondence/contradictions/unresolved aliases/traversal with confidence/continuity/result-kind filters, pagination, bounded-depth cap).

Files created: src/umd/projections/{base,checkpoint,poison,current,search,vector,query,publish,tables,embedder,__init__}.py; migrations/versions/0004_projections.py; tests/test_projection_phase2.py. Files modified: src/umd/config.py (ProjectionSettings), tests/conftest.py (truncate list += search_document, projection_generation), pyproject.toml (per-file-ignore ARG002 for projections builders), src/umd/storage/postgres/tables.py (unchanged). Gates recorded: pgvector 0.8.0 present but below 0.8.2 -> HNSW gated; pg_trgm 1.6 active.

Verification: `make lint` ruff zero errors; `.venv/bin/mypy src` zero errors in 134 files; `UMD_TEST_POSTGRES=true pytest` -> 338 passed (326 baseline + 12 new; zero prior tests modified/weakened). Deviations: blue/green PgVector HNSW stays gated (0.8.0<0.8.2) so recall/immutability proven on the exact fallback; vector embeddings require a real NOT-NULL segment_id (builder skips units without a segment); QueryService temporal/spatial scope are currently hook-parameters (not deep filters) pending Phase-3 typed input.

No blockers.

title: Phase 3 re-dispatch: api package audited, test plan confirmed
body:
Re-dispatch discovery: prior worker wrote the FULL src/umd/api/ package (app.py factory, auth.py API-key/bearer + write gate, consistency.py read-your-writes guard w/ transient-lag + rebuild-in-progress 503, errors.py RFC7807, pagination.py opaque cursors, ratelimit.py token-bucket, deps.py AppContext, schemas.py Pydantic v2, routers/{sources,entities,claims,segments,alignment,jobs,query,search,audit,system}.py, runner.py SynchronousRunner). No api test files exist. Verified `make lint` (ruff) and `mypy src` (strict, 155 files) both pass. The api package wires real Phase1/2 services; projections are never written by routes.

TEST-PLANNING FACTS (survive compression):
- mypy command: .venv/bin/mypy src ; lint: .venv/bin/ruff check (tests have per-file S-rule ignores).
- httpx>=0.27 already in pyproject dev deps -> TestClient available, NO dep change needed.
- Fixtures: umd_db (function-scoped migrated engine, truncates _UMD_APP_TABLES before+after), source_store (session-scoped SourceStore.create root, max_upload 512KB, max_range 4KB, content-addressed -> shared OCFL safe).
- create_app(*, engine, source_store, settings=None). For tests pass engine=umd_db, source_store=source_store, settings=Settings(auth=AuthSettings(api_keys=['write-key','read-key'],write_keys=['write-key']), rate_limit=RateLimitSettings(enabled=True,requests_per_window=10000,burst=100), consistency=ConsistencySettings(lag_wait_multiplier=1,max_waiters=16), lag_budget_seconds=0.05).
- Auth headers: W={'Authorization':'Bearer write-key'} (can read+write), R={'Authorization':'Bearer read-key'} (read-only -> POST = 403 Forbidden).
- Build projections after writes: ReplayDriver(engine, ProjectionCheckpointStore(engine)).run(CurrentTierOneBuilder(), wipe=True) and .run(SearchProjectionBuilder(), wipe=True, force_resume=...) . Projection names: 'current_tier1' (query_guard, poison_enabled=False) and 'search' (search_guard).
- ConsistencyGuard ensures: tokened read with token=ledger_tail after build -> fresh 200 (FreshnessMeta). If no checkpoint (applied_seq=0<tail) -> 503 x-consistency:transient-lag. If ProjectionCheckpointStore.save(ProjectionCheckpoint('current_tier1',applied_seq=0).paused('...',0)) -> 503 x-consistency:rebuild-in-progress, retry-after>=30, x-rebuild-estimate.
- Ingest: POST /v1/sources json {media_kind,txt,content,content_type} -> 201 SourceDescriptorResponse(source_id, ocfl_ref=store_path, sha512, consistency_token). Job id = f"job-{source_id[:12]}", status derives 'complete' (SynchronousRunner marks all STAGE_ORDER complete).
- Source-native locator: GET /v1/locators/{obj_id} where obj_id = "urn:umd:ocfl:source:sha512:"+sha512 (from descriptor). data_b64 decodes to ingested content.
- Structured query: POST /v1/query/structured {kind:'UTTERANCE', filters:{speaker}, consistency_token} -> ProvenanceBearingPage w/ results, bound_report.bounded True, freshness. Semantic: POST /v1/query/semantic {question:'what does e:hero say'} -> compiled_ops contains UTTERANCE, provenance.authority contains no 'RAG'. Search: POST /v1/search {query,mode:'exact'} -> hits each have kind/label, freshness.
- Entities: POST /v1/entities {ref,label,kind:CHARACTER} -> CANONICAL_ENTITY assertion (needed for ENTITY query + /v1/entities list). Pagination: GET /v1/entities?limit=1 -> next_cursor; follow with cursor=...
- Correction: POST /v1/segments/{id}/edit (no body) -> record_correction CORRECTION_APPLIED -> returns consistency_token.
- RFC7807: no key -> 401 problem+json (content-type application/problem+json, type urn:umd:problem:*, code). read-only write -> 403 forbidden. unknown -> 404 not_found. rate-limit dedicated app (requests_per_window=2,burst=0) -> 3rd request 429 with retry-after.
- System: GET /v1/health (ok|degraded), /v1/ready (200|503), /v1/capabilities (query_max_depth==4, semantic_authority=='tier0-ledger; projections never authoritative'), /v1/version (contract_version '1.0.0'), /openapi.json (FastAPI auto, paths contain /v1/query/structured).

title: Plan D Phase 4 DONE — query scope filters, REST resolution, evidence retrieval
body:
Phase 4 (P4-S1..S10) of Plan D implemented, fixing the 3 Round-2 QA findings. All 10 steps complete with annotations.

QUERY SCOPE FILTERS (src/umd/projections/query.py + routers/query.py):
- Added ScopeUnmappableError + _parse_uuid/_parse_dt + QueryService._scope/_continuity_pred/_temporal_pred/_spatial_pred (shared bounded SQL-scope path).
- continuity_id: indexed subquery table.source_id IN (SELECT id FROM source WHERE continuity_id=:cid) on SCENE/EVIDENCE/UNRESOLVED_ALIASES (source-chain ops).
- temporal: _temporal_pred over new indexed segment.start_time/end_time, open-ended overlap bounds (from->end>=from, to->start<=to), SCENE op.
- spatial: _spatial_pred `segment.metadata_ @> CAST(json AS JSONB)` ({"spatial":...}) with GIN index, SCENE op.
- Unmappable scope on any op -> ScopeUnmappableError -> routers/query.py -> RFC 7807 422 code 'unmappable_scope' (caught before generic invalid_query 400). Never silent unfiltered.
- NEW MIGRATION 0005_scope_filters.py: segment.start_time/end_time TIMESTAMPTZ + ix_segment_start_time/end_time + GIN ix_segment_metadata_gin. tables.py declares the columns WITHOUT index=True (so 0001's metadata.create_all doesn't pre-create indexes out of order); migration uses CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for idempotent re-upgrade. (First attempt used op.create_index + index=True and collided with create_all — fixed.)

REST RESOLUTION (app.py/deps.py/entities.py):
- Wired Resolver(ledger, PostgresSplitEnumerator, PostgresMentionRepository, engine, PostgresQuarantine.record) into build_context, exposed via AppContext.resolver. No second semantic authority, no route projection writes.
- entities.py merge/split handlers now call ctx.resolver.merge/.split instead of event-append-only SemanticCommandService.entity_resolve. Split gained required `targets` list query param. ResolutionRejected/no-targets -> 422 (invalid_merge/invalid_split). Append-only EntityResolved event + consistency_token=commit.seq retained.

title: Phase-2 deployment/recovery implementation notes
body:
Key non-obvious findings while implementing Phase 2 (P2-S1..S4):
1. migrations/env.py resolves the DSN from UMD_POSTGRES_DSN (or settings) and OVERRIDES the AlembicConfig sqlalchemy.url at migrate time. So run_migrations(dsn)/readiness_probe must pin UMD_POSTGRES_DSN=dsn for the call (restore prior env) — otherwise they migrate/probe the wrong database. Also use ScriptDirectory.get_heads vs alembic_version comparison for 'at head', NOT alembic_command.check (autogenerate) which flags pre-existing model drift (removed indexes on search_document) unrelated to migration application.
2. OCFL object dirs contain BOTH an object-level inventory.json AND version v<N>/inventory.json; naive rglob('inventory.json') double-counts. Object discovery must skip dirs named v<digits>.
3. SourceStore.verify_fixity and get_range RAISE (StoreError/OSError/FileNotFoundError) when a content file is missing — they do not return False/garbage. Test the spool/FUSE failure as a raised exception, not a boolean.
4. A v1 SemanticAsserted (no 'scope') cannot be appended through SemanticLedger (validates against latest schema v2 which requires scope). To test old-version readability, simulate a legacy snapshot by rewriting the backup ledger record to event_version=1 / no scope + recomputing the manifest sha256, then restore (which upcasts v1->v2 on replay while keeping the stored row at v1).
5. restore setval must use sa.text(...).bindparams (sa-level named param), not exec_driver_sql with :name (psycopg positional style).

title: SPEAKER candidate_speaker is utterance-indexed when diarization gated
body: In P1-S4 audio conformance I found that with pyannote diarization gated (UMD_DIARIZATION_ENABLED unset), Evidence rows of kind 'audio_interval' carry quality.candidate_speaker as PER-UTTERANCE labels ('speaker_unknown_utterance_1..N'), NOT true speaker clusters. So asserting N distinct speakers is only meaningful when diarization is active; when gated, the honest assertion is: distinct utterance observations preserved, no conflation, no promotion. The promotion_ban dict lives on 'speaker_observation' evidence quality, and build_audio_evidence_plan requires source_id to be a real UUID. Future Phase-2/3 audio tests should gate speaker-count assertions on diarization capability and assert utterance-level preservation otherwise.

title: Vector projection wipe-and-replay was blocked by immutable trigger; fixed
body: Discovery: EmbeddingProjectionBuilder.wipe() was BLOCKED by the immutable-embedding trigger (block_embedding_mutate, migration 0001) once the embedding store was non-empty — a BEFORE DELETE ... FOR EACH ROW trigger fires per-row, so earlier tests that wiped only an EMPTY vector store (test_operational_phaseE::test_projection_rebuild_catches_up_through_builder) never hit it. This violated the DD/REPLAY gate 'every Tier-1 projection wipes to seq=0 and replays'. Fix: added migration 0006_projection_wipe_gate.py redefining block_embedding_mutate() to honour a transaction-scoped GUC umd.projection_wipe='vector'; EmbeddingProjectionBuilder.wipe() now set_config()s it immediately before its DELETE. All non-builder UPDATE/DELETE on embedding stays blocked (test_embedding_immutable_supersession_never_deletes still expects DBAPIError on UPDATE). Added tests/test_phase2_replay_acceptance.py proving wipe-and-replay of ALL THREE Tier-1 projections (current_tier1/search/vector) from seq=0, no authoritative event skipped, only-builders-write across all stores, and query-cost cap.

title: P3-S4 found + repaired latent defect: entity-describe question path called non-callable SearchService
body: Genuine defect found during P3-S4 12-probe review. QuestionService.answer() ENTITY/describe branch (src/umd/projections/question.py:~171) called `self._search(query=entity, limit=c.limit)`, but build_context wires `search=SearchService(engine)`, which is NOT callable (only .exact/.fuzzy/.hybrid). Any "describe <entity>" / who/what question would raise TypeError -> HTTP 500, violating DD acceptance criterion 8 (semantic queries). Existing suite/docs never hit it (docs example only uses UTTERANCE + search directly). REPAIRED via worker path: `self._search(query=...)` -> `self._search.hybrid(query=...)`. Must use the `write` tool to create or overwrite a file (the `edit`/`architecture`/`write` distinction triggers against the decoder). Verified KindTaggedSearchPage.hits has .ref/.kind/.label/.text/.source_id/.score matching the mapper. Added a describe-question assertion to test_phase3_correction_e2e S1 to regression-test the path. Complete suite rerun after the repair: 469 passed/4 skipped/0 failed, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean.
